title: Pesticide applicator commercial applicator categories and certification practice questions
description: Practice questions on EPA commercial applicator categories, competency, age, exam standards and exceptions (40 CFR 171.101, 171.103).

questions.topic: Commercial categories by site and setting
questions.question: A commercial applicator applies restricted use pesticides to seeds. Under 171.101(d), where must that use take place for the seed treatment category to apply?

options.A: In forest nurseries and forest seed production areas
options.B: In seed treatment facilities
options.C: Only on the farm where the seed will be planted
options.D: Only at a dealership that sells the seed

questions.explanation: Seed treatment "applies to commercial applicators using or supervising the use of restricted use pesticides on seeds in seed treatment facilities." Forest nurseries and forest seed production belong to forest pest control in 171.101(b).

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Commercial categories by site and setting
questions.question: An applicator certified only in livestock pest control wants to buy and use sodium fluoroacetate livestock protection collars. What does 171.101(a)(2) say about that certification?

options.A: It authorizes the use as long as the applicator is at least 18 years old
options.B: It authorizes use on livestock the applicator owns, but not on others' livestock
options.C: It authorizes supervising others' use, but not using the product personally
options.D: It alone is not sufficient to authorize the purchase, use, or supervision of use of those predator control products

questions.explanation: 171.101(a)(2) says "Certification in this category alone is not sufficient to authorize the purchase, use, or supervision of use of products for predator control listed in paragraphs (k) and (l) of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Commercial categories by site and setting
questions.question: The aquatic pest control category covers restricted use pesticides purposefully applied to standing or running water. Which applicators does 171.101(e) exclude from it?

options.A: Applicators engaged in public health related activities included in the public health pest control category
options.B: Applicators applying to running water rather than standing water
options.C: Applicators applying to ponds on private land
options.D: Applicators who are governmental employees

questions.explanation: The aquatic category covers "any restricted use pesticide purposefully applied to standing or running water, excluding applicators engaged in public health related activities" in paragraph (h).

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Commercial categories by site and setting
questions.question: The crop pest control category in 171.101(a)(1) covers use of restricted use pesticides in production of agricultural commodities. Besides crops such as grains, vegetables and tree fruits, which lands does its list of examples name?

options.A: Forests and forest nurseries
options.B: Golf course turf and ornamental plantings
options.C: Feed and forage crops including grasslands, and non-crop agricultural lands
options.D: Railway rights-of-way

questions.explanation: Crop pest control covers production of agricultural commodities, "including but not limited to grains, vegetables, small fruits, tree fruits, peanuts, tree nuts, tobacco, cotton, feed and forage crops including grasslands, and non-crop agricultural lands." Forests, turf and rights-of-way have their own categories in 171.101(b), (c) and (f).

questions.topic: Categories for government programs, research, predator control, fumigation and aerial use
questions.question: Under 171.101(h), to whom does the public health pest control category apply?

options.A: Any commercial applicator who treats human dwellings
options.B: Private applicators protecting their own households
options.C: State, Tribal, Federal or other governmental employees and contractors using restricted use pesticides in government-sponsored public health programs
options.D: Extension specialists who demonstrate pesticide use to the public

questions.explanation: The category "applies to State, Tribal, Federal or other governmental employees and contractors who use or supervise the use of restricted use pesticides in government-sponsored public health programs."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Categories for government programs, research, predator control, fumigation and aerial use
questions.question: An extension agent does not apply restricted use pesticides personally but supervises a public demonstration of their proper use and application techniques. What does 171.101(j) say about the demonstration and research category?

options.A: It applies to individuals who demonstrate to the public the proper use and techniques of application of restricted use pesticides or supervise such demonstration
options.B: It applies only to persons who personally apply restricted use pesticides during a demonstration
options.C: It applies only to persons conducting field research, not to demonstrations
options.D: It applies only to State and Federal employees, not to commercial representatives

questions.explanation: 171.101(j): the category "applies to individuals who demonstrate to the public the proper use and techniques of application of restricted use pesticides or supervise such demonstration" and to persons conducting field research. It includes "extension specialists and county agents, commercial representatives demonstrating restricted use pesticide products".

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Categories for government programs, research, predator control, fumigation and aerial use
questions.question: Under 171.101(i), the regulatory pest control category applies to governmental employees and contractors who use or supervise the use of restricted use pesticides in government-sponsored programs for what purpose?

options.A: The management and control of pests having medical and public health importance
options.B: The control of regulated pests
options.C: Demonstrating the proper use of restricted use pesticides to the public
options.D: Field research involving restricted use pesticides

questions.explanation: 171.101(i) covers employees and contractors "who use or supervise the use of restricted use pesticides in government-sponsored programs for the control of regulated pests." Programs for pests of medical and public health importance fall under public health pest control in 171.101(h).

questions.topic: Categories for government programs, research, predator control, fumigation and aerial use
questions.question: A commercial applicator, working from the ground, will use a restricted use pesticide to fumigate a sealed shipping container of stored goods. Which of these 171.101 certification categories covers that use?

options.A: Soil fumigation
options.B: Seed treatment
options.C: Aerial pest control
options.D: Non-soil fumigation

questions.explanation: 171.101(n): non-soil fumigation "applies to commercial applicators who use or supervise the use of a restricted use pesticide to fumigate anything other than soil." Soil fumigation in 171.101(m) covers use "to fumigate soil", and aerial pest control covers pesticides "applied by fixed or rotary wing aircraft."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.101, Commercial applicator certification categories (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.103(a)(2)(vi), commercial applicator examinations must be kept secure so that who has access to the examination, and when?

options.A: The candidates and their employers, at any time
options.B: Only the candidates, and only in the presence of the proctor
options.C: Any certified applicator, after the examination period
options.D: The candidates, alone, during breaks in the examination

questions.explanation: Examinations "must be kept secure before, during, and after the examination period so that only the candidates have access to the examination, and candidates have access only in the presence of the proctor."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Besides a passing score on a written examination that meets the 171.103(a)(2) standards, what must a commercial applicator also pass to be determined competent under 171.103(a)?

options.A: Any related performance testing that is required by the State, Tribe, or Federal agency
options.B: An oral examination given by EPA
options.C: A supervised work period of 12 months
options.D: A refresher course from the pesticide manufacturer

questions.explanation: The applicator "must receive a passing score on a written examination that meets the standards specified in paragraph (a)(2) of this section and any related performance testing that is required by the State, Tribe, or Federal agency."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A certifying authority wants to add performance testing as an additional method of determining commercial applicator competency. Under 171.103(b), where must that method be specified?

options.A: In the labeling of each pesticide used in the test
options.B: In a notice EPA publishes for each test session
options.C: In the certifying authority's Agency-approved certification plan
options.D: On each applicator's certification credential

questions.explanation: 171.103(b) says "Any such additional methods must be specified in the certifying authority's Agency-approved certification plan and must comply with the applicable standards in paragraph (a) of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.103(a)(2)(ii), who may proctor a commercial applicator examination?

options.A: Any certified commercial applicator in the category being tested
options.B: The candidate's employer or supervisor
options.C: Any EPA employee, without designation by the certifying authority
options.D: An individual designated by the certifying authority who is not seeking certification at that session

questions.explanation: The examination "must be proctored by an individual designated by the certifying authority and who is not seeking certification at any examination session that he or she is proctoring."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: During a commercial applicator examination, the proctor sees a candidate attempting to copy the examination. Under 171.103(a)(2)(xi), to whom does the proctor report it?

options.A: The certifying authority
options.B: The candidate's employer
options.C: The registrant of the pesticide named in the examination
options.D: Local law enforcement

questions.explanation: "The proctor reports to the certifying authority any examination administration inconsistencies or irregularities, including but not limited to cheating, use of unauthorized materials, and attempts to copy or retain the examination."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A candidate wants to use a personal copy of a pesticide label during a commercial applicator examination. Which reference materials does 171.103(a)(2)(ix) allow during the examination?

options.A: Any materials the candidate brings, once the proctor has inspected them
options.B: Only those approved by the certifying authority and provided and collected by the proctor
options.C: Any pesticide labeling, because labels are public documents
options.D: Any materials the candidate's employer has approved

questions.explanation: "The only reference materials used during the examination are those that are approved by the certifying authority and provided and collected by the proctor."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.103(a)(2)(vii), with whom may a candidate have verbal or non-verbal communication during a commercial applicator examination period?

options.A: Other candidates, about examination procedures only
options.B: Their employer, by phone during breaks
options.C: Only the proctor
options.D: Any certified applicator present in the room

questions.explanation: "Candidates must not have verbal or non-verbal communication with anyone other than the proctor during the examination period."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Core standards for all commercial applicators
questions.question: Under 171.103(c), which of the core areas of competency must the written examinations for all commercial applicators address?

options.A: Only the areas related to the categories the applicator seeks
options.B: Any areas the proctor selects at the examination session
options.C: Only the areas for which no category-specific standard exists
options.D: All of the areas of competency listed in 171.103(c)

questions.explanation: 171.103(c) says "Written examinations for all commercial applicators must address all of the following areas of competency."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A person seeks commercial applicator certification in two categories. Under 171.103(a), what must the examinations and any alternate methods used to determine competency include?

options.A: The core standards applicable to all categories and the standards applicable to each category in which the applicator seeks certification
options.B: The standards for one of the two categories, chosen by the applicator
options.C: Only the core standards applicable to all categories
options.D: Only the standards for the two categories

questions.explanation: Examinations and any alternate methods "must include the core standards applicable to all categories (paragraph (c) of this section) and the standards applicable to each category in which an applicator seeks certification."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Examinations for each 171.101 category must be based on the competency standards in 171.103(d)(1) through (15) and on what else?

options.A: The applicator's past pest control work history
options.B: The list of pesticides the applicator's employer uses
options.C: Examples of problems and situations appropriate to the particular category in which the applicator is seeking certification
options.D: Questions supplied by pesticide manufacturers

questions.explanation: Category examinations "must be based on the standards of competency specified in paragraphs (d)(1) through (15) of this section and examples of problems and situations appropriate to the particular category in which the applicator is seeking certification."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: In addition to the demonstration and research standards, what must applicators in that category demonstrate under 171.103(d)(10)?

options.A: A degree in a pest-related science
options.B: Competency in each pest control category applicable to their demonstrations
options.C: Five years of field research experience
options.D: Competency in every category listed in 171.101

questions.explanation: 171.103(d)(10) says "In addition, they must demonstrate competency in each pest control category applicable to their demonstrations."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.103, Standards for certification of commercial applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A Doctor of Veterinary Medicine applies a restricted use pesticide to a patient during the course of the ordinary practice of veterinary medicine. What does 171.103(e) say about the requirements in 171.103(a)-(d) for this person?

options.A: They apply in full, as for any commercial applicator
options.B: Only the minimum age requirement applies
options.C: Only the core standards in 171.103(c) apply
options.D: They do not apply to this person

questions.explanation: "The requirements in § 171.103(a)-(d) of this part do not apply to the following persons," which include "Doctors of Medicine and Doctors of Veterinary Medicine applying restricted use pesticides to patients during the course of the ordinary practice of those professions."
